column1: # Expected hashes of crates/rcfd-io/tests/w41d_tet_quality.rs (ADR 0190). Columns: key, platform (any, windows, linux-x86_64), hash.
# W0: default options give the fingerprints (cell count, Mesh::content_hash) recorded at HEAD a2e0bfd (e325ab4 in the current history) before any
# library change (the ADR 0104 smoke table), so the default output is bit-identical. Written as decimals in the source; the same numbers here.
# The registered values were recorded on Windows; the surfaces call the platform's libm (sin, cos), so coordinates, cell counts and hashes differ
# per platform. The x86_64 Linux value was proven equal at the reference commit and at HEAD in one container (ADR 0137); other platforms print the
# fingerprint and skip. The cell counts stay in the test source.
